description: Push the object towards the opening, switch contact and push again to store it in the corridor.
Push the object in an ungraspable pose toward the wall, flip it to expose a graspable edge, and grasp it.
Pull the object from between two obstacles, push toward the wall, flip it to expose a graspable edge, and grasp it.
Push the object in an ungraspable pose toward the wall, flip it to expose a graspable edge, pull to expose a graspable edge, and grasp it.
Push an object toward the wall, flip it to align with an opening between the wall and the object, then pull it into the opening for storage.
Pivot the box to align with the storage opening, push it toward the opening, and then push it through the opening into the storage space.
Topple the cheez-it box by pressing on the top of it to expose a graspable edge, and grasp it.
Move the book to the edge of the platform to expose a graspable edge, and grasp it.
